answer: A dune town behind the harbor stays honest when every new identity must win entry to the shared vault by convincing a distinct panel of established keepers. The first fake needs 3 keepers, the second 6, the third 9, since the nth fake needs 3 times n keepers, so the tenth fake alone needs 30 and twenty fakes need 630. Bulk farming fails because each keeper vouches for only one identity per epoch and interviews every applicant live, like one gatekeeper stamping a single vault key per tide. Buying a panel fails too, since a keeper caught vouching for a fake loses the seat and that trust.
